regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES header: signature, PRG/CHR sizes and mapper69 agree with rom.info.

regions.label: ChrPatternTiles
regions.evidence: Header-bounded CHR ROM; NES fixed 16-byte two-bitplane pattern tiles, 16384 tiles. Physical CHR storage separate from CPU PRG. Inspected tile bytes and section boundaries; no PRG execution view.

regions.label: NmiHandler
regions.evidence: Validated interrupt/reset vectors and connected direct control flow, reviewed fixed-walk.txt. Mapper69 E000-FFFF fixed last 8KiB bank; mapper writes cannot change this slot. Calls outside fixed bank not classified. Return fallthrough assumes standard returning JSR contract; no execution claimed.

regions.label: ResetEntry
regions.evidence: Validated interrupt/reset vectors and connected direct control flow, reviewed fixed-walk.txt. Mapper69 E000-FFFF fixed last 8KiB bank; mapper writes cannot change this slot. Calls outside fixed bank not classified. Return fallthrough assumes standard returning JSR contract; no execution claimed.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Last fixed-bank bytes are three little-endian CPU vectors: NMI E1D0, reset E2E6, IRQ E2A9; targets independently reviewed as coherent interrupt/reset routines.
